descriptionFull: The Mexican chickadee ( Poecile sclateri ) is a small songbird, a passerine bird in the tit family Paridae. It is still often placed in the genus Parus with most other tits, but mtDNA cytochrome b sequence data and morphology suggest that separating Poecile more adequately expresses these birds' relationships (Gill et al. , 2005). The American Ornithologists' Union had been treating Poecile as distinct genus for some time already.
